notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}.
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Rite of Harmony triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
